about: What a person or the note decided about single ENHANCE.PET studies, read by tools/gold3_ct.py as data. The rules in the tool are general and run on every study; this record only names the studies whose reading a person or the note settled, each with the reason and where it is written. Nothing here was repaired except the three under repaired.

labelling_error.why: the body below L4 is labelled L6 and there is no L5, a skipped label; the lowest ribs are 12 on T12, so the L6 label is very likely L5
labelling_error.source: docs/research/enhance-pet-gold-tier-3.md, What the ribs say; the Claude project's files, enhance-pet-repair/README.md

labelling_error.why: every rib leads on the label one level up, the first rib on C7, so the labels sit one level high from the thorax down and the five lumbar bodies are labelled T12 and L1 to L4
